criteria.notes: Current or next program dominates the surface while one timely announcement remains integrated as support; both requested target sizes are represented.
No external visual reference was supplied; review followed the instruction-led civic arts venue direction in the brief.
Warm gallery-neutral palette, framed civic venue composition, and program-first hierarchy avoid generic dashboard/card layouts.
Program time, state, title, and location remain readable at 1920x1080 and 800x480; compact removes secondary prose first.
Light and dark screenshots preserve readable contrast and coordinated accent usage.
Long program and announcement titles, rich text summaries, and missing location fallback stay contained with visible descenders.
Full HD and compact layouts fill the canvas without looking like two separate dashboards; feed-only mode promotes one announcement without duplicating the support rail.
Icon and placeholder are app-specific; broken or absent feed media hides cleanly without a broken image.
Uses provider normalization mechanics from examples but distinct venue-pulse composition, palette, and hierarchy.
